name: Citi Trends
known_for: Apparel and Home Trends for Less
notes: 2026-10-29 (rainbow page run): cititrends.com is a brand site with a store finder and no online shop. Title 'CITITRENDS - Apparel & Home Trends For Way Less Spend'; meta 'Shop the trends and hot brands at one of 600+ stores for men’s, ladies, kids, home décor & more. Up to 50% less than the others.' known_for from that title.

About Us: 'a leading off-price retailer of Apparel, Accessories and Home with a differentiated focus on the Black consumer'; HQ Savannah, Georgia; 'nearly 600 neighborhood-based stores across 33 states'. 10-K filed 2026-04-15: 590 stores in 33 states as of January 31, 2026; Women's division 27% of sales, 'apparel for juniors, missy and plus size'; mix of 'privately developed brands and nationally recognized labels' (so kind retailer).

Sells dresses: 10-K filed 2024-04-18 (FY2023): 'Our stores include a wide assortment of sportswear, dresses, outerwear, intimate apparel…'. The 2026 10-K's Women's line lists sportswear, outerwear, sleepwear, lingerie and scrubs without naming dresses. No online prices (store only).

Refund and Exchange Policy: refund or exchange within 30 days of purchase with receipt and original tag; no refunds on clearance, undergarments, worn or altered items. SEC files fetched with the StylodexBot UA only (no contact email sent).
